name: Crisis Support
title: Crisis Support
opening: When **war** comes, it doesn't wait. Neither should the help.
pivot: It was never a *shortage* of good people. It was a **matching** problem.
resolution: One protocol. Helpers and the helped, paired in **minutes**. Not days.
closer: The world is bigger than the crisis. If we can find each other, it **stays** that way.

projects.label: Crisis Support Program
projects.blurb: Match verified helpers to people in need, in minutes not days.

name: Mental Health
title: Mental Health
opening: We treat the mind like a lawyer. We call it only when something has already **broken**.
pivot: The mind is a *muscle.* Untrained muscles **atrophy**.
resolution: A gym for the mind. Two minutes a day. Focus. Memory. The reps are **small**. The compounding is enormous.
closer: You already *have* a brain. We just help you **use it**.

projects.label: Brain Gym
projects.blurb: Two-minute focus workouts, delivered as daily reps.

projects.label: Total Recall
projects.blurb: Rebuild your memory one card, one session, one day at a time.

name: Special Sounds
title: Special Sounds
pivot: Before pills, there were **frequencies**. The body still remembers.
resolution: Binaural beats for focus. Solfeggio for calm. A generator for your *own* recipe.
closer: Sound is the **oldest** medicine. Now it's a click away.

projects.label: Binaural Beats
projects.blurb: Pre-mixed binaural frequencies for focus, calm, and deep sleep.

projects.label: Binaural Generator
projects.blurb: Design your own binaural recipe. Pick the tones, set the intent.

projects.label: Solfeggio Frequency
projects.blurb: Ancient sacred tones for modern nervous systems.

name: Autonomous AI
title: Autonomous AI
opening: AI that *talks* is everywhere. AI that **does** is still rare.
pivot: Intelligence without hands is a philosopher. Hands without intelligence is a worker. We are building **both**.
resolution: Agents that ship code. Agents that plan careers. Agents that *finish* the job you started.
closer: The chasm between 'can answer' and 'will act' is the **only** chasm that matters now.

projects.label: SaaaS
projects.blurb: Software as an Agentic Service. Ships working code, not suggestions.

projects.label: Agentic AI Deck
projects.blurb: The thesis, the landscape, the architecture. One deck.

projects.label: AI Career Explorer
projects.blurb: An agent that maps your next career move from your skills.

name: Sovereign AI
title: Sovereign AI
opening: Your **prompts** are your thoughts. They shouldn't live on someone else's server.
pivot: The stack used to fit in a datacenter. Now it fits on a **laptop**.
resolution: A blueprint. Local models. Local memory. Local *agency*. You own the brain you built.
closer: The future has a **choice** in it. Sovereign or subscribed.

projects.label: Sovereign AI Blueprint
projects.blurb: A step-by-step guide to owning your entire AI stack on your own hardware.

name: Cultivate Inner Intelligence
title: Cultivate Inner Intelligence
opening: We scaled the *outer* intelligence. We forgot the **inner** one.
pivot: Consciousness is the last **unclaimed** frontier. You can map it. You just have to **look**.
resolution: A book, to map the terrain. A simulation, to rehearse *letting go*. Two doors to your own mind.
closer: The most interesting thing you will ever build is **yourself**.

projects.label: Book Reader
projects.blurb: A book about the inner operating system, read directly in the browser.

projects.label: Ego Death Simulation
projects.blurb: A guided simulation to rehearse letting go of the self.

name: Self Help
title: Self Help
opening: The shelf is full of *advice*. What's missing is the **tool**.
pivot: **Rituals** beat resolutions. The body learns what it repeats.
resolution: Two tools. Three minutes each. Update your mind. *Reflect* on your day. Do it again tomorrow.
closer: The smallest practices, kept the **longest**, change the most.

projects.label: Update Mind
projects.blurb: Refresh your mental model every morning with a three-minute ritual.

projects.label: My Reflection
projects.blurb: A daily mirror for your thoughts. Write, read back, notice.
